title: Turns all around us
description: A grey wall line and a teal door line meeting at a point, with a purple arc showing the turn, and a separate amber straight stick.

title: A crease makes a segment
description: A paper rectangle with one straight teal crease whose two end points are labelled A and B.

title: Shortest route from A to B
description: Points A and B joined by a curved grey route, a zig-zag grey route and a straight teal route, with the straight one marked shortest.

title: A line never ends
description: A long grey line with arrowheads at both ends and a short teal part between points A and B.

title: The torch beam is a ray
description: A teal ray starting at amber point T, passing point L and continuing to the right with an arrowhead.

title: Book cover makes an angle
description: A teal base arm and an amber cover arm of equal length meeting at a purple vertex dot.

title: Wider turn, larger angle
description: Two angles with equal arms: a narrow teal one labelled Case 1 and a wider amber one labelled Case 2.

title: Mouths open wider
description: Three angles with equal arms in a row, opening wider from left to right, labelled smallest, middle and largest.

title: Overlap to compare
description: Two identical angles AOB in teal and XOY in amber, and below them one overlapped angle where both coincide.

title: Close angles look alike
description: Two nearly identical angles, teal and amber, with a purple question mark between them.

title: Comparing angles by overlapping
description: Two same-length arm pairs: a narrow teal angle and a wide amber angle, each with a small arc at the joint.

title: Angle is the turn
description: Two angles with exactly the same opening: one with short arms and one with long arms, both teal, labelled same angle.

title: Folding a straight angle
description: A horizontal line AB with O in the middle and a vertical ray OC; the left angle teal and the right angle amber are equal.

title: Quarter of a turn
description: Three equal circles: a full turn, a half turn shaded teal, and a quarter turn shaded amber with a right angle mark.

title: Less, right, more
description: Three angles in a row: a narrow teal acute angle, a grey right angle with a square mark, and a wide amber obtuse angle.

title: Degrees in key angles
description: A teal right angle labelled 90 degrees and an amber straight angle labelled 180 degrees.

title: Equal parts of a circle
description: Two same-size circles: one cut into 4 equal parts with one teal part marked 90 degrees, one cut into 6 equal parts with one amber part marked 60 degrees.

title: Two scales on a protractor
description: A grey protractor outline with a teal scale running 0 to 180 from the right and an amber scale running 0 to 180 from the left.

title: Angles from one arm
description: A base ray OP and two rays OQ and OR at 35 and 95 degrees, with the angle POQ teal marked 35 and the angle QOR amber marked 60.

title: Reading an angle
description: A grey protractor with the vertex O at its centre, base arm OA on 0 and arm OB crossing the scale at 80 degrees.

title: Folding a circle in half
description: One full circle marked 360° and one semicircle marked 180° whose single crease makes two equal parts of 90° each.

title: Finding 45° and 135°
description: A semicircle in four equal wedges with one wedge shaded teal as 45° and the other three shaded amber as 135°.

title: Angle bisector by folding
description: A right angle of 90° with a dashed crease through the middle splitting it into two equal 45° angles, the crease labelled bisector.

title: Using the protractor correctly
description: A protractor with its centre dot on the angle vertex, one arm along the 0 line and the other arm reading 35°.

title: Angle between clock hands
description: A clock face at 5 o'clock with 12 even ticks and an arc across 5 hour gaps marked 150°, each gap 30°.

title: Drawing a 30° angle
description: A base ray IN and a second ray IT making an angle of 30° at the vertex I, with the arc marked 30°.

title: Guess and true angle
description: Three rays from one vertex: a base, a dashed guess ray at 39° and a solid true ray at 49°, with the 10° gap shaded.

topic_name: Types of Angles by Their Measure
title: Four kinds of angle
description: A row of four angles of 35°, 90°, 120° and 180°, named acute, right, obtuse and straight.

topic_name: Types of Angles by Their Measure
title: Reflex angle at a vertex
description: Two rays from a vertex with the inside angle of 100° in teal and the reflex angle of 260° in amber, adding to 360°.

topic_name: Types of Angles by Their Measure
title: Angles on a straight line
description: A straight line with a ray from its middle point making 80° on one side and 100° on the other.
